Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one standalone game HUD weapon thumbnail.
Image 1 is the STRICT STYLE AND LAYOUT STANDARD: a clean SOLID WHITE SIDE-PROFILE WEAPON SILHOUETTE with very few transparent functional openings, no drawing or shading, on an empty transparent canvas.
Image 2 is the EXACT CURRENT PROJECT WEAPON / SHAPE SOURCE. Convert THIS weapon into the silhouette style of image 1. Preserve its recognizable side outline, geometry, proportions and distinct major attachments. Do not invent another weapon.
The exact RIFLE shown in image 2. Preserve its rear stock at left, long chunky organic-edged upper receiver, elevated compact tubular optic on top, rearward box magazine hanging below the left-middle, forward pistol grip and trigger opening, and the thick suppressor/muzzle section on the far right. Do not draw curling vine lines inside the silhouette.
Output one square PNG with genuine alpha transparency. Complete weapon centered horizontally and vertically, muzzle or cutting tip pointing RIGHT, perfectly level strict orthographic side view with no foreshortening. Weapon width about 82 percent of the canvas, even 9 percent left/right margin; retain original aspect ratio so remaining vertical space is transparent. PURE OPAQUE WHITE SILHOUETTE only. Merge touching parts and surface decoration into a cohesive simple filled shape. Only large true open spaces such as trigger guard, stock gap or grip loop may be cut out as transparent. Exterior boundary clean and smooth with just necessary silhouette features. No interior contour strokes, no colored material, no gray, no black outlines, no shading, no lighting, no reflections, no gradients, no noisy distressed edge, no grunge, no speckles, no smoke or flash, no ammunition, no hands, no arms, no character, no background tile, no text or logos. Match image 1's simplicity instead of tracing texture from image 2. Exactly ONE weapon per image.
